utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still checking the repair order, but I should be able to confirm those first homes soon. If anyone hears new details, send them my way and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll keep checking our supplies and send you any updates that might help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — that’d help a lot. I’ll send the first homes as soon as I confirm the order.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Uli — please send me the repair drive location and the best route there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll send it over right away, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep an eye out for the location and route details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ve got gloves and a flashlight; should I head straight to Ira, or is there something else you want me to pick up?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still only hearing bits, so I’m not sure yet. Have they said whether roofs or plumbing is first?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet — I’ve only heard it’s getting organized. I’ll ask Ira and let you know if roofs or plumbing comes first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Noah — we’re short on nails, some paint, and a ladder if anyone has one. I’ll keep sending you the homes that still need help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it — I can look for nails and a ladder. Send me the homes, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Appreciate it, Noah. I’ll send the next homes over as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Any update on the repair drive, Tess? I’m out running errands, so I can pass along anything that’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Not yet, Ira — I still haven’t heard any fresh updates, but I’m keeping an ear out. I’ll pass along anything new as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out and can spread the word if anything comes in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I can help sort and bring gloves. What time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — thanks, Bo. I’ll bring the wrench and screwdriver, and you can come by whenever works best for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll swing by and help sort when I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m still in for the repair drive. Just send me the time and place again so I don’t mix it up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll send the time and place again, and I’ll also check what tools and donation-sorting help we still need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey — that’d help a lot. I’m happy to pitch in once I’ve got the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Late Saturday morning works for me too. I’ll spread the word and help line up a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great, Mara — thank you. I’ll keep things around late Saturday morning and send you the simple list of tasks.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — send me the task list when you can, and I’ll keep recruiting neighbors around late Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rosa sounds like the main contact, so I’m still waiting on the timing. Once it’s firm, I’ll let you know so you can bring the tools by.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep the list updated. Send me any homes or tool needs, and I’ll make sure everything’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works. I’ll keep track of any homes and tool needs and pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’re still on for Saturday morning, and we could use a few more hands for sorting and simple fixes. If you can, bring gloves, any extra tools, and let me know if you’ve got a table for the tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m still on for Saturday morning. I’ll bring gloves and a few extra tools, and I’ll check if I can bring a table too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s fantastic, Sam — thanks for pitching in. Just let me know about the table when you can, and I’ll keep you posted on the details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Kira. Let’s keep it simple and start with the repair list by priority.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you can still help with the repair drive this week, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I can still help this week—send me the repair list and I’ll sort it by priority.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still on it, and I’ll keep spreading the word for the repair drive this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep the details aligned and check in on the time, drop-off spot, and what people should bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll keep inviting neighbors and send anyone over once you confirm the time and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ve got the location. Can you confirm who’s coordinating and whether the time is still set, so I can check the rest?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Uli’s coordinating it, and the time is still set for this afternoon. I can help with the supplies and setup once you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks — I’ll double-check the rest and then we can lock in the supplies and setup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Still on Saturday morning—what should I bring for the repair drive this time?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning works for me. Please bring gloves, a tape measure, and any basic tools you have, and we’ll sort the rest at the school.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring gloves, a tape measure, and some basic tools. See you Saturday morning at the school.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah — I really appreciate you helping with the repair drive this afternoon. I’ll keep an eye out for your update.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What should I handle first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Could you check what supplies we still need and let me know what you find?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — I’m checking the time and place with Rosa now, and I’ll send it over as soon as I have it. Sorting donations would be a big help too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Cleo — thanks. I’m still happy to help sort donations, and just send me the time and place when you have it so I don’t mix it up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do, Oren — I’m asking Rosa now and I’ll send you the time and place as soon as I have it. Thanks again for helping sort the donations.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still on for this week, and I’ll keep rounding up neighbors for the repair drive this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Quinn — that’s a big help. If you can, send folks my way for the latest and remind them to bring gloves and any extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll send folks your way and remind them to bring gloves and any extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I still haven’t heard which repair they’re starting with, but I’m asking around and I’ll pass along anything solid right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Tess — I’m still checking too, and I’ll confirm the first homes as soon as I can. If you hear anything solid, send it my way and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Dane — I’ll pass along anything solid as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — timing and coordination are still the big things I need pinned down, so please send them as soon as you hear back from Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll check with Rosa and send you the timing and who to contact as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — that’s exactly what I need. I’ll wait for Rosa’s timing and contact info, and then I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — could you send me the repair drive location and the easiest route there?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll send you the location and the easiest route there in a moment.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — I’ll keep an eye out for the location and route details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces so far—what are they fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still checking on the first repair, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I know. I’m keeping the word moving so everyone has the time, place, and task.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. Just let me know when you hear the first fix, and I’ll keep an ear out too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, and I’m keeping the list organized. If you know any homes that need help, send them my way and I’ll add them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep it simple and send over any homes that need help. Please keep the list in priority order when you can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the list in priority order and update it as homes come in. Send me any new ones whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, any update on the repair drive? I’m out running errands, so I can pass along anything you need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still able to help with the repair drive this week, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I’m still able to help this week. Just let me know what you need me to pass along.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
